document�How often do we retry a declined card?
Dunning retries a declined card on days 1, 3, 5 and 7 after the first failure, then marks the subscription past_due. The schedule lives in billing/dunning/schedule.ts.
billing/dunning/schedule.ts

document�Where do invoice PDFs get generated?
The invoice-renderer worker builds each PDF with headless Chromium and uploads it to the invoices-prod bucket. Customers receive a signed link that stays valid for 7 days.
Invoice rendering runbook

document�How is proration calculated when a customer upgrades mid-cycle?
We credit the unused days of the old plan and charge the new plan for the remainder, computed to the day in UTC. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal with no refund.
billing/proration.ts

document�Why do we see duplicate Stripe webhook events?
Stripe delivers at least once. handleStripeEvent dedupes on event.id in the table stripe_events_seen with a 30-day TTL, and a duplicate returns 200 with no side effects.
billing/webhooks/stripe.ts

document�What does error PAY-4021 mean?
PAY-4021 means the tax calculation service timed out while an invoice was being finalized. The invoice stays in draft and the reconcile job tries again within an hour. Act only if it lasts longer than 4 hours.
Billing error catalogue

document�What does error PAY-4012 mean?
PAY-4012 means the customer's billing country is missing, so tax cannot be calculated. Support has to ask the customer to complete the address; retrying does nothing.
Billing error catalogue

document�Who can issue refunds and up to what amount?
Support agents can refund up to 200 USD from the admin console. Anything larger needs a finance lead's approval through the refund-approvals queue, and after 180 days a refund must be issued as a credit note.
Refund policy

document�How do we store money amounts?
Every amount is an integer in minor units with its ISO 4217 currency code, in the Money type of billing/money.ts. Floats are forbidden by the lint rule no-float-money. JPY has zero decimals.
billing/money.ts

document�What happens when a free trial ends without a card on file?
The workspace becomes read-only for 14 days and is then suspended. Its data is kept for 90 days after suspension. trialExpiryJob runs hourly.
billing/trials/expiry.ts

document�How long does a login session last?
Web session cookies last 12 hours with sliding renewal, capped at 30 days in absolute terms by SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TTL. API tokens do not expire until they are revoked.
auth/session.ts

document�How do we rotate the SAML signing certificate?
Upload the new certificate in the admin SSO settings and leave both active for a 72-hour overlap. Customers' identity providers pick it up from /saml/metadata. Ops removes the old one once the overlap ends.
SSO runbook

document�What causes AUTH-1107 at login?
AUTH-1107 means the SAML assertion's clock skew went over the allowed window, usually because of the customer's identity provider clock. The window is SAML_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS, 300 by default.
Auth error catalogue

document�How can a user get back in after losing their MFA device?
They use a recovery code. If those are gone too, support verifies the person through their workspace admin and runs admin mfa reset, which is written to the audit log.
MFA support procedure

document�Which password hashing do we use?
argon2id with 64 MiB of memory, 3 iterations and parallelism 1, set in auth/hash.ts. A stored hash is upgraded at the next successful sign-in when the parameters change.
auth/hash.ts

document�How are the JWT signing keys rotated?
The key-rotator cron creates a new RS256 key every 30 days and publishes it in /.well-known/jwks.json 24 hours before first use. A retired key stays published for 7 days.
auth/keys/rotator.ts

document�How do we protect login from brute force?
Ten failures per account in 15 minutes locks that account for 15 minutes. A hundred failures per IP in an hour answers HTTP 429. The counters are the Redis keys login_fail:*.
auth/throttle.ts

document�Why does the OAuth callback fail with redirect_uri_mismatch in preview environments?
Preview deploys have random hostnames that Google does not know. They go through the auth-proxy at auth-preview.internal, the one registered URI; set OAUTH_PROXY_ENABLED=true.
Preview environments guide

document�How do internal services authenticate to each other?
mTLS through the mesh with SPIFFE IDs, and no shared credentials. Policy is in infra/mesh/authz.yaml, and a new service has to add its SPIFFE ID there.
infra/mesh/authz.yaml

document�How do we add a NOT NULL column without downtime?
Over three deploys: add the column as nullable with a default, backfill in batches of 1000, then add a NOT VALID check and VALIDATE it before setting NOT NULL. Never in one migration.
Schema change guide

document�Why did a migration fail with a lock timeout?
Migrations run with lock_timeout=5s so that they never queue behind a long transaction and stall traffic. On 'canceling statement due to lock timeout', look for long report queries and try again off-peak.
Schema change guide

document�What's the database connection pool size in production?
PgBouncer in transaction mode with default_pool_size 40 per database and max_client_conn 2000, and app pools of 10 per pod. Session-level SET and prepared statements do not work through it.
infra/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini

document�When is it safe to read from a replica?
Only reports and lists may read from a replica, never a flow that has just written. The router falls back to the primary when pg_replica_lag_seconds goes over 2.
Database read routing

document�How do we restore a production database backup?
WAL-G takes nightly base backups to S3 with point-in-time recovery for 14 days. Restore to a new instance with wal-g backup-fetch and replay to the target time; expect about 40 minutes per 100 GB. See ops/runbooks/pg-restore.md.
ops/runbooks/pg-restore.md

document�What should we do when we see SQLSTATE 40P01 in the orders service?
40P01 is a deadlock. The orders service locked order rows then inventory rows while the bulk import locked them in reverse. withRetry retries 3 times, and the lasting fix was locking in id order.
orders/repo.ts

document�What primary key type do new tables use?
UUIDv7, generated in the application by newId(), so inserts stay local in the index. bigint serials remain only in legacy tables (ADR-19).
ADR-19

document�Why did bloat on the events table get so high?
Autovacuum could not keep up with the churn. We set autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.01 on that table and partitioned it by month, so old partitions are dropped rather than deleted.
Events table postmortem

document�Do we soft delete rows?
Only users and workspaces carry deleted_at; everything else is removed outright. Soft-deleted rows are purged after 30 days by the purge_deleted job.
Data lifecycle policy

document�What's the retry policy for background jobs?
Exponential backoff from a 30-second base, doubling with jitter, for at most 8 attempts, and then the dead letter queue. A job can set its own maxAttempts.
jobs/runner.ts

document�How do I replay jobs from the dead letter queue?
Run jobctl dlq list, then jobctl dlq replay --queue emails --since 2h. A replay keeps the original idempotency key, so work already done is not repeated.
Job queue runbook

document�What does JOB-503 mean?
JOB-503 means a worker lost its lease: it missed heartbeats for 60 seconds and another worker took the job. The old worker's writes are refused by the fencing token. The usual cause is a GC pause or a node drain.
Job queue error catalogue

document�What does JOB-530 mean?
JOB-530 means a job payload went over the 256 KiB limit when it was enqueued. Put large payloads in the blob store and enqueue a reference.
Job queue error catalogue

document�Are jobs processed in order?
There is no ordering guarantee except within a key: jobs with the same orderingKey run one at a time. Emails use the recipient id as that key.
jobs/queue.ts

document�What timezone do cron schedules use?
All of them are in UTC, in jobs/schedules.yaml. Anything that has to follow a customer's local time works out its next run in code.
jobs/schedules.yaml

document�How many jobs does one worker run at once?
20 per pod on IO queues and 2 on the CPU-heavy image queue, set by WORKER_CONCURRENCY. KEDA scales the pods on queue depth.
Worker sizing notes

document�What happens to running jobs during a deploy?
Workers get SIGTERM, stop taking new work and have 90 seconds to finish (terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 120). Whatever is unfinished returns to the queue when its lease expires, so every job must be idempotent.
Worker lifecycle notes

document�How do we prevent sending an email twice when a job retries?
Each send first writes an outbox row keyed by template, recipient and dedupe_key, and a unique constraint refuses the second one, before the provider is called.
email/outbox.ts

document�How do I roll back a bad production deploy?
deployctl rollback api --to previous points the service at the last image within 2 minutes. Do not revert migrations: schema stays backward compatible for one release.
Deploy runbook

document�How do deploys reach production?
Argo Rollouts sends 5% for 10 minutes and aborts on its own if 5xx goes over 1% or p99 rises 20%, then 50%, then 100%.
Deploy runbook

document�When are deploys frozen?
Fridays after 15:00 UTC, during a declared incident, and from December 20 to January 2. The freeze-override label needs on-call approval.
Release calendar

document�How does CI caching work in the monorepo?
Turborepo's remote cache sits in S3, keyed by input hashes that include the lockfile, so a dependency bump rebuilds everything. A cold run takes 25 minutes and a warm one 6.
CI notes

document�Which base image do services use?
Distroless Node 24 pinned by digest, which Renovate bumps weekly. It has no shell, so debug with an ephemeral container through kubectl debug.
docker/base.Dockerfile

document�How are features released gradually?
LaunchDarkly flags named team.feature, with a kill switch required on anything risky. A flag is removed within 30 days of reaching 100%, and the stale-flags lint reports the rest.
Feature flag guide

document�What does CI-117 mean on the merge queue?
CI-117 means the rebased branch no longer passes the required check schema-lock. Run pnpm db:lock and commit the result.
CI error catalogue

document�Where do we keep application secrets?
In Vault, injected at pod start by the vault agent sidecar, never in env files or the repository. Rotate with vault kv put and restart; gitleaks runs in CI.
Secrets guide

document�How are release notes produced?
Each pull request adds a .changeset file. The release bot collects them weekly into CHANGELOG.md and posts the result in #releases.
Release guide

document�Which alerts page on-call at night?
Only SEV1 and SEV2 page, through PagerDuty. SEV3 goes to the Slack channel #alerts. The rules are in observability/alerts/*.yaml.
observability/alerts

document�What is the API availability target?
99.9% over 30 days. The error budget burn alerts fire at 14.4x over one hour and at 6x over six hours.
SLO definitions

document�How long do we keep application logs?
30 days hot in Loki and one year archived in S3. The log-scrubber removes personal data before ingestion.
Logging standard

document�What's our trace sampling rate?
OpenTelemetry tail sampling keeps every error and every request slower than 1 second, and 1% of the rest. See otel/collector.yaml.
otel/collector.yaml

document�Where is the dashboard for queue depth?
In Grafana, folder Platform, dashboard Queues Overview. Its main panel reads the metric job_queue_depth.
Grafana index

document�Why did Prometheus run out of memory last quarter?
Someone added a user_id label to http_requests_total and the series count exploded until the process was OOM-killed. A relabel rule now drops it and the CI lint promlint-cardinality stops new ones.
Prometheus postmortem

document�How do we run an incident?
Declare it with /incident new in Slack, which opens a channel and names a commander. For SEV1 the status page is updated every 30 minutes. The postmortem is due within 5 business days.
Incident guide

document�How do we know the login flow works in production?
Checkly runs the login and checkout flows every 5 minutes from 3 regions, and two consecutive failures page on-call.
Synthetic checks

document�What are the default API rate limits?
1000 requests per minute per token with a burst of 200, on a sliding window in Redis; enterprise plans get 10000. Over the limit answers 429 with Retry-After.
gateway/limits.ts

document�What does GW-4291 mean?
GW-4291 means the tenant-wide quota is used up, as opposed to the per-token limit. It resets at midnight UTC, and sales can raise it.
Gateway error catalogue

document�What does GW-4219 mean?
GW-4219 means a request body went over the 10 MiB limit on an upload route. Large files have to use a presigned upload.
Gateway error catalogue

document�What's the gateway's upstream timeout?
30 seconds for the API and 300 seconds for /exports; past that the client gets a 504. Long work must answer 202 and let the client poll.
gateway/routes.yaml

document�How do we version the public API?
By date, in the header Api-Version such as 2026-06-01. Old versions stay supported for 18 months, and their end is announced with the Sunset header.
API versioning policy

document�Why are browser requests from customer domains blocked?
Allowed origins are per workspace in the table cors_origins, and the gateway caches them for 5 minutes. Wildcards are not accepted, so the customer's exact origin must be listed.
gateway/cors.ts

document�How do customers verify our webhooks?
X-Signature carries an HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp and body under a per-endpoint key. Receivers should refuse anything older than 5 minutes.
Webhook docs

document�How does the API handle a repeated POST?
The Idempotency-Key header is stored for 24 hours per token. The same key with the same body returns the stored response; a different body answers 409.
gateway/idempotency.ts

document�How do I rebuild the search index?
searchctl reindex --alias docs --zero-downtime builds a new OpenSearch index and swaps the alias at the end. Production takes about 3 hours.
Search runbook

document�Why do search results lag behind edits?
Indexing runs from Debezium CDC through the Kafka topic search.docs, normally under 10 seconds. An alert fires when consumer lag reaches 5 minutes.
Search architecture

document�Why doesn't search find hyphenated product names?
The standard analyzer splits on the hyphen. The custom sku_analyzer uses word_delimiter_graph with preserve_original. A mapping change needs a reindex.
search/mappings/products.json

document�How is the title weighted over the body?
title^3 and body^1, with a gauss recency decay over 30 days, in search/query-builder.ts.
search/query-builder.ts

document�What is SRCH-702?
SRCH-702 means too many clauses: the query went over 1024 boolean clauses, usually from a very large filter list. Use a terms lookup instead.
Search error catalogue

document�How does search respect document permissions?
Each query filters on acl_groups, resolved from the user's groups and cached for 60 seconds, so someone removed from a group can still see titles for up to a minute.
search/acl.ts

document�What powers the search box suggestions?
The completion suggester on the suggest field, by prefix, top 5, debounced by 150 ms in the UI.
search/suggest.ts

document�What colour is the banner on the login page?
The sign-in banner uses the design token color.brand.teal600, set in web/src/auth/SignInBanner.tsx.
web/src/auth/SignInBanner.tsx

document�What do we use for client state?
TanStack Query for server state and Zustand for small pieces of UI state. Redux is gone.
Frontend architecture

document�What's the JavaScript bundle size limit?
250 KB gzipped for the initial route, enforced by size-limit in CI, which fails the pull request. Charts are lazy-loaded to stay under it.
web/.size-limit.json

document�How are translations handled?
FormatJS messages are extracted into locales/*.json and synced with Crowdin every night. Never build a sentence by concatenation.
Localization guide

document�Why do we get 'Hydration failed' on the dashboard?
A date was rendered in the server's timezone and again in the browser's. Wrap it in ClientOnly or format it in UTC.
web/src/dashboard/DateCell.tsx

document�What accessibility standard do we follow?
WCAG 2.2 AA. axe runs inside the Playwright suite, and every modal must work from the keyboard alone.
Accessibility checklist

document�Where do design tokens come from?
Figma exports through style-dictionary into packages/tokens. Never hard-code a hex value; a lint rule refuses it.
packages/tokens

document�Why was LCP on the pricing page poor?
The hero image was an uncompressed 2 MB file. Moving to AVIF with a priority preload took LCP from 4.1 s to 1.9 s.
Web performance notes

document�How do cluster nodes scale?
Karpenter provisions spot nodes for workers and on-demand nodes for stateful sets, and consolidates every 5 minutes.
infra/karpenter/provisioner.yaml

document�Why did api pods go into CrashLoopBackOff after a config change?
The startup check exits 1 when REDIS_URL is missing, so the pod restarts forever. kubectl logs --previous shows the message.
Kubernetes troubleshooting

document�What are the memory limits for the api pods?
1.5 GiB request and 2 GiB limit, with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536. The image-processor needs 4 GiB or it ends OOMKilled.
infra/helm/api/values.yaml

document�Why were there intermittent DNS timeouts in the cluster?
ndots:5 made every external lookup try five search domains and overloaded CoreDNS. We set ndots:2 and enabled NodeLocal DNSCache.
DNS postmortem

document�How are cloud resources changed?
Through Terraform in infra/terraform: Atlantis plans on the pull request and applies after approval, never from the console. State is in S3 with a DynamoDB lock.
infra/terraform

document�Which regions do we run in?
eu-west-1 is the primary and us-east-1 serves US tenants. Residency is set per tenant and failover is manual.
Regions overview

document�How are TLS certificates renewed?
cert-manager with Let's Encrypt over DNS-01, renewing 30 days before expiry. An alert fires at 14 days.
infra/cert-manager

document�Why do we get 502s during pod rollouts?
Nginx keeps sending to pods that are terminating. A preStop sleep of 15 seconds lets the endpoints update before SIGTERM.
Ingress troubleshooting

document�Why is the checkout e2e test flaky?
It raced the tax iframe's load by waiting on network idle. The fix is an explicit waitFor on the frame; adding retries is not allowed.
e2e/checkout.spec.ts

document�Why do integration tests use Testcontainers?
They run against a real Postgres 18 in Testcontainers, one per worker, because the earlier SQLite setup behaved differently from production.
Testing strategy

document�What do we do with a flaky test?
Tag it @quarantine within a day and file a ticket; the owner has 2 weeks. Quarantined tests run nightly and block nothing.
Testing strategy

document�Is there a minimum code coverage?
No global percentage. Changed lines must reach 80%, checked by diff-cover on the pull request.
Testing strategy

document�How should test data be created?
With the factories in testutil/factories and a fixed faker seed, never from shared seed files.
testutil/factories

document�How do tests control time?
Inject the Clock and use FakeClock. Calling Date.now() directly is refused by the lint rule no-real-time.
testutil/clock.ts

document�How do we load test before launches?
k6 scripts in perf/ run against staging at twice the peak, and the pass line is p95 under 300 ms.
perf/README

document�Why do vitest runs fail with 'Hook timed out in 10000ms' on CI?
Starting the container takes longer than the default hook timeout on busy runners, so the integration config sets hookTimeout to 120000.
vitest.integration.config.ts

document�When does the warehouse export run?
The Airflow DAG warehouse_export runs at 02:00 UTC and loads into Snowflake through S3, with its SLA at 06:00.
airflow/dags/warehouse_export.py

document�How do we honour a GDPR deletion request?
privacy erase --user removes the rows within 30 days and leaves a tombstone in the warehouse. Backups age out after 14 days.
Privacy runbook

document�Why do large CSV exports fail?
Synchronous exports stop at 10,000 rows. Anything bigger has to run as a streamed job to S3 with a link sent by email, and that job runs out of memory past 1 million rows unless it pages.
exports/csv.ts

document�How do Kafka schema changes get approved?
Avro schemas live in the schema registry under BACKWARD compatibility, and the CI check schema-compat refuses a breaking change.
Kafka guide

document�What does a dbt test failure on stg_orders mean?
The unique_order_id test failed because of a late duplicate CDC event. The model keeps the row with the latest lsn.
dbt/models/stg_orders.sql

document�How long are Kafka topics retained?
7 days by default and 30 days for search.docs. Config topics are compacted instead.
Kafka guide

document�How is personal data masked in the warehouse?
A Snowflake masking policy applies to every column tagged pii, and the analyst role sees a hash.
Warehouse access guide

document�Who gets alerted if the revenue dashboard is stale?
A Monte Carlo freshness monitor posts to #data-alerts, and the data-platform on-call owns it.
Data quality notes
